summary.text: Judson Sapp represents District 20, which covers Putnam County and parts of Clay, Marion and St. Johns counties, in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Sapp was elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Sapp lives in Middleburg and is CEO of a railroad construction company.
Sapp holds a bachelor's degree in philosophy from Florida State University.
